gallery.blurb: A text zoomer: huge block letters spelling HELLO, ROOM, DANCE and TOGETHER zoom in from far away to fill the screen and burst, one after another, with a radial speed blur behind.
gallery.prompt: A text zoomer: huge block letters spelling HELLO, ROOM, DANCE and TOGETHER zoom in from far away to fill the screen and burst, one after another, with a radial speed blur behind. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
